verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is a hosted API, so API versioning and a deprecation policy are fair questions to ask of it. The evidence pack documents many request headers and features but never mentions versioned endpoints, version pinning, or a deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probes also returned 404, so there is no versioned spec either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
